layout.hierarchy: Title dominates (large bold text, red/blue). The two plot panels are equal-sized secondary elements. Captions in dark red bold sit beneath each plot. Slide number is small.

visual_elements.description: Left scatter plot: red L-shaped axes (vertical axis up with arrowhead, horizontal axis right with arrowhead), no ticks or axis labels. Three clusters of filled circles with dark outlines: a green cluster of ~10 points on the left/center, a cyan cluster of ~9 points upper-right, and an orange/tan cluster of ~7 points at the bottom. A small cursor arrow icon appears near the orange cluster. Caption below: 'Data of Three Classes'.

Right scatter plot: same axes and same three clusters (green ~10 points, cyan ~9 points, orange ~7 points). A single red filled circle (outlier) sits between the green and cyan clusters. Thin gray/pink lines connect each point to its nearest neighbor, with small red arrowheads/dots indicating direction; many lines from all three clusters converge on the red outlier and its neighboring green point. The green point closest to the red outlier is highlighted with a dashed red circle. Caption below: 'Nearest Neighbor is the Green class'.
Thin dark-red double rectangular border framing the entire slide content, with an additional inner border around the title area.
Yellow circle with dark outline containing the number '45' (slide number badge).
